title: San Juan del Sur
style: mellow acoustic latin folk, 92 bpm, nylon guitar, soft cajon, ocean ambience low, warm honest vocal, no swearing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Five years on the Pacific side
Dunedin first, then Perth, then the tide
Pulled the family south to a town with a sun
That sets where the next page is already begun

[Verse 2]
Ruby and Wesley sleep through the night
Michelle holds the gate she didn't ask to hold tight
Twenty-five years in tech, never the loudest one
Just the one who reverse-engineered the run

[Chorus]
San Juan, San Juan del Sur
The kids say dad is the strongest, sure
San Juan, the sun goes down
And tomorrow the audit comes around

[Bridge]
The mansion isn't a mansion, the mansion is a house
The house is full of work, the work is full of doubt
The doubt got named, the doubt got logged
The log became the song
The song is San Juan del Sur

[Outro]
Pacific side. Five years deep.
Doors close, doors open, the kids sleep.
San Juan. McIVOR. 336.
The lane is the lane. The mix is the mix.
